mcq_questions.description: ﻿y=λx(1−x)=λx−λx2⇒dydx=λ−2λxমূলবিন্দুতেdydx=λ−0=λ⇒λ=tan30°=13y = \lambda x(1-x)=\lambda x - \lambda x^2 \Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} =\lambda - 2\lambda x মূলবিন্দুতে \frac{dy}{dx}=\lambda - 0 = \lambda \Rightarrow \lambda = tan30\degree = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}y=λx(1−x)=λx−λx2⇒dxdy​=λ−2λxমূলবিন্দুতেdxdy​=λ−0=λ⇒λ=tan30°=3​1​﻿
